h1: Private House Interior Design, Custom Furniture & Turnkey Renovation in Berlin, 215 m²

blocks.text: Private House Interior Design, Custom Furniture & Turnkey Renovation in Berlin, 215 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN developed a comprehensive interior design project for a 215 m² private house in Berlin, Germany. The project combined interior design, technical documentation, custom furniture design and manufacturing, and comprehensive turnkey renovation.

The house interior was designed with an emphasis on contemporary aesthetics, functionality and everyday comfort. The space planning takes into account the architectural features of the building, connections between rooms, furniture and appliance placement, integrated storage solutions and lighting scenarios.

The project covers the living room, bedrooms, kitchen with built-in appliances, walk-in wardrobes, entrance hall, bathrooms and functional storage areas. All spaces follow a cohesive interior design concept, with carefully considered materials, colour combinations, lighting and furniture solutions.

Custom-made furniture was designed and manufactured specifically for the private house, including the kitchen, built-in wardrobes, walk-in closets, shelving and storage systems. Each furniture element was developed according to the room dimensions, layout requirements and overall interior style, ensuring efficient use of space and a consistent visual identity throughout the home.

The preparation stage included technical documentation and a detailed cost estimate covering construction and finishing works, materials, furniture, household appliances, bathroom fixtures, lighting and other elements specified in the project.

Following the design stage, a comprehensive turnkey house renovation in Berlin was completed in accordance with the developed interior solutions and technical documentation. The implementation included construction and finishing works, installation of custom-made furniture and preparation of the residential spaces.

Photorealistic 3D visualizations were created to present the proposed interior before implementation. They provide a detailed preview of the layouts, materials, furniture, lighting solutions and overall atmosphere of the rooms.

This 215 m² private house project demonstrates DUMSKAYA DESIGN’s comprehensive approach to contemporary residential interiors — from initial design development and technical documentation to custom furniture production and complete project implementation.
